common.disclaimerText: DiaSense AI provides AI-assisted health screening and educational recommendations for informational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional clinical diagnosis or emergency medical care. Consult a certified medical practitioner for definitive clinical evaluation.

home.heroDesc: Assess your physiological health markers, evaluate risk indicators powered by machine learning, and receive actionable, personalized lifestyle and nutritional recommendations.
home.featuresDesc: DiaSense AI integrates machine learning inference with comprehensive clinical health analytics.
home.feat1Desc: Supervised machine learning model trained on physiological markers to screen for early diabetes vulnerability.
home.feat2Desc: Detailed parameter breakdown highlighting high-impact risk factors such as Glucose, BMI, Age, and Insulin.
home.feat3Desc: Tailored meal plans providing low-glycemic dietary guidance customized to your risk level and preferences.
home.feat4Desc: Risk-aware physical workout plans designed to improve insulin sensitivity and glycemic stability.
home.feat5Desc: Generate and download official PDF health risk assessment reports for clinical reviews.
home.feat6Desc: JWT authentication, bcrypt password hashing, and user-isolated authorization (IDOR security).
home.howDesc: A seamless four-step screening process connecting patient inputs to clinical machine learning insights.
home.step1Desc: Provide physiological markers including Fasting Glucose, Blood Pressure, BMI, Insulin, and Family History.
home.step2Desc: Our pre-trained XGBoost Classifier analyzes your input features against clinical decision thresholds.
home.step3Desc: View your risk classification, statistical probability score, and high-impact contributing factor breakdowns.
home.step4Desc: Access your tailored diet/exercise recommendations and download an official PDF medical summary.
home.ctaTitle: Ready To Evaluate Your Diabetes Risk Profile?
home.ctaDesc: Takes less than 3 minutes. Receive instant AI classification, detailed contributing factor analysis, and tailored diet recommendations.

about.title: About DiaSense AI
about.desc: An AI-assisted diabetes risk screening and personalized health guidance platform engineered with machine learning classification models.
about.missionDesc: DiaSense AI was developed as an enterprise-grade full-stack computer science project demonstrating practical artificial intelligence applications in healthcare risk screening. The application utilizes supervised machine learning (XGBoost) trained on physiological parameters to classify diabetes vulnerability, calculate risk probabilities, and provide clinical factor explainability.
about.evaluationDesc: Stratified Train-Test Split with Feature Engineering & Sensitivity Metrics
about.frontendDesc: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Recharts
about.multilingualDesc: 6 Indian & Global Languages with Voice AI
